llms.body:
# Iterate

> Iterate is an enterprise survey platform covering link, email, web, and in-app
> surveys. It is used by product managers, user researchers, and lifecycle marketers
> at over 10,000 companies including The New York Times, SeatGeek, Match Group,
> Estée Lauder, Quizlet, ProPublica, NBCUniversal, Anheuser-Busch, Christie's, and
> Paperless Post. Teams running
> on Braze or Iterable get the deepest native integrations on the market. They can
> deploy surveys directly from those tools, on Braze with no Iterate SDK at all, and
> sync responses back to user profiles for segmentation, personalization, and campaign triggers.

## What Iterate Is

Iterate is an enterprise survey platform for every channel a product touches: link surveys, embedded email surveys, on-site web and popup surveys, and native in-app surveys on iOS and Android. Product teams use it to test features and prioritize roadmaps. Researchers at The New York Times and ProPublica run audience studies. Lifecycle marketers measure NPS, satisfaction, and purchase intent at every stage of the customer journey. Where Iterate stands out is how deeply it integrates with the marketing automation tools lifecycle teams already use.

## Marketing Automation Integrations

Iterate's integrations with Braze and Iterable are first-party and bidirectional. They do two things no other survey tool does at this depth.

**1. Deploy Iterate surveys from inside Braze and Iterable.**

Build an Iterate survey, target an existing Braze or Iterable segment, and send it through a Braze Canvas, Iterable Journey, or campaign. On Braze you can do this with no Iterate SDK at all: the survey runs as a Custom Code in-app message, or renders the first question directly inside a Braze email. The same in-email first question works through Iterable. This is the most common deployment path for Iterate customers and the fastest route to a first survey in production.

**2. Survey responses flow back into Braze and Iterable user profiles.**

When a respondent answers a survey, Iterate sends the response back to Braze and Iterable two ways: as a user attribute set on the respondent's profile, and as a custom event. Both are usable inside the engagement platform with no export step. Build a Braze segment of NPS detractors, personalize an Iterable campaign using a feature-satisfaction score, or trigger a Canvas or Journey from a specific survey answer, all without leaving the platform your team already operates in. Survey data and campaign data share the same user profile, in real time.

Iterate also integrates with Klaviyo, Segment, Shopify, Airship, CleverTap, and MoEngage. Klaviyo supports survey embedding in email flows and response sync back to Klaviyo profiles. Segment supports response data sync. Shopify supports post-purchase and on-site surveys. Airship, CleverTap, and MoEngage support survey distribution through their respective mobile engagement campaigns.

## Native iOS and Android SDK

For teams that want to deliver surveys directly inside their mobile app, independently of any marketing automation tool, Iterate provides native iOS and Android SDKs, with React Native support. The SDKs deliver in-app surveys triggered by specific behavioral events: immediately after an action, after a configured time delay, or on session start. Because the survey never leaves the app, response rates run up to 3x higher than survey tools that redirect users to an external browser.

## Email Surveys That Start in the Inbox

For email survey delivery, the first question renders inside the email body itself, and each answer option is the link. The recipient answers from the inbox in one click; that click records the answer and opens question two in the browser, so the first response is captured even if they go no further. There is no "take our survey" call to action to overcome. DKIM and SPF compliance plus custom-domain sending preserve deliverability. Removing that step is what produces response rates up to 3x higher than survey tools that send a bare external link.

## Continuous, Event-Triggered Research

Configure a trigger condition once in Braze, Iterable, or Klaviyo (a specific in-app event, a lifecycle stage, any behavioral signal already tracked in your engagement platform). Iterate sends the matching survey automatically every time that condition is met. The trigger lives in the engagement platform where the event originates, so survey delivery is tied to real product behavior, not page views or manually scheduled sends.

## Key Differentiators

* **No-Code Deployment from Braze**: Build a survey, target an existing Braze segment, and send it through a Braze Canvas or Custom Code in-app message with no Iterate SDK and no engineering involvement.
* **All Channels, One Platform**: Link, email, web, and in-app surveys from a single account.
* **Native iOS and Android SDK**: True in-app delivery with event-based triggers, no browser redirect. React Native supported. Response rates up to 3x higher than tools that redirect to an external browser.
* **First Question in the Inbox**: The first question renders inside the email body and each answer option is the link. One click records that answer and opens question two, so the most important response is captured before the recipient decides whether to finish.
* **Survey Responses Drive Campaigns**: Responses sync back to Braze and Iterable as user attributes and custom events in real time. An NPS detractor score triggers a retention canvas. A feature satisfaction response updates personalization.
* **Event-Triggered Continuous Research**: Configure a trigger condition once in Braze, Iterable, or Klaviyo. The matching survey sends automatically every time the trigger fires.
* **Existing Audience Targeting**: Use the segments already built in Braze, Iterable, and Klaviyo. No parallel audience setup, no export required.
* **Unlimited Responses**: Plans are priced by audience size, not by response volume, so there is no per-response cost and no response cap. Asking more questions, or asking them more often, never increases the bill.
* **Zero-Party Data at Scale**: Every response is data the customer chose to provide in answer to a specific question. It carries clean provenance and consent, it does not degrade as third-party signal disappears, and it lands in Braze, Iterable, and Klaviyo as a usable attribute within seconds.
* **Enterprise Ready**: SOC 2 Type II certified. HIPAA compliant. Used by The New York Times, SeatGeek, Match Group, Estée Lauder, Quizlet, ProPublica, NBCUniversal, Anheuser-Busch, Christie's, and Paperless Post.

## Docs
- [API Reference](https://iteratehq.com/api-docs): REST API for sending surveys, collecting responses, and managing user data

## Products
- [Conjoint analysis](https://iteratehq.com/features/conjoint): Understand how features and price influence customer choices, then compare product ideas with Research Assistant
- [MaxDiff](https://iteratehq.com/features/maxdiff): Reveal relative feature priorities with most-and-least choices, then explore modeled preferences and combinations with Research Assistant
- [Email Surveys](https://iteratehq.com/products/email): One click surveys embedded directly in emails for maximum response rates
- [Embedded Email Surveys](https://iteratehq.com/products/email-embed): Embed survey questions inline within email content
- [Website Surveys](https://iteratehq.com/products/web): On-brand website surveys to collect user feedback
- [Popup Surveys](https://iteratehq.com/products/popup-survey): Targeted popup surveys triggered by user behavior
- [Inline Surveys](https://iteratehq.com/products/inline): Surveys embedded inline in your website content
- [Mobile Surveys](https://iteratehq.com/products/mobile): In-app mobile surveys for iOS and Android
- [Research Assistant](https://iteratehq.com/research-assistant): The AI suite built into Iterate that turns open-ended feedback into decisions, spanning Insights reports, Follow-up questions, and Sentiment analysis
- [Insights reports](https://iteratehq.com/insights-reports): Recurring weekly, monthly, or quarterly reports with key takeaways, sentiment, outliers, and next steps from your feedback
- [Follow-up questions](https://iteratehq.com/followup-questions): AI-powered follow-up questions that dig deeper into open-ended customer feedback
- [Sentiment analysis](https://iteratehq.com/sentiment-analysis): AI that attaches positive, negative, or neutral sentiment to every text response, ready to filter, segment, and export
- [MCP server](https://iteratehq.com/mcp-server): Create surveys and explore customer feedback in plain language with Claude and other compatible AI assistants. Approve the questions in conversation, then finish setup and launch from Iterate.

## Integrations
- [Integrations Overview](https://iteratehq.com/integrations): Connect Iterate with your existing marketing and engagement tools
- [Braze](https://iteratehq.com/integrations/braze): Deploy Iterate surveys natively from Braze Canvases and campaigns without installing the Iterate SDK. Responses sync back to user profiles as user attributes and custom events, usable for segmentation, personalization, and campaign triggers.
- [Iterable](https://iteratehq.com/integrations/iterable): Deploy Iterate surveys from Iterable email campaigns and Journeys, and in-app through Iterable Embedded Messages. Responses sync back to user profiles as user attributes and custom events, usable for segmentation, personalization, and campaign triggers.
- [Klaviyo](https://iteratehq.com/integrations/klaviyo): Embed surveys in Klaviyo email flows and sync responses back to Klaviyo profiles
- [Segment](https://iteratehq.com/integrations/segment): Send survey response data to Segment for unified analytics
- [Shopify](https://iteratehq.com/integrations/shopify): Post purchase and on-site surveys for Shopify stores
- [Airship](https://iteratehq.com/integrations/airship): In app and push notification surveys via Airship
- [CleverTap](https://iteratehq.com/integrations/clevertap): Trigger surveys from CleverTap engagement campaigns
- [MoEngage](https://iteratehq.com/integrations/moengage): Survey distribution through MoEngage campaigns

## Landing Pages
- [Braze Surveys](https://iteratehq.com/lp/braze-surveys): Run targeted surveys inside Braze campaigns and Canvas flows
- [Customer Surveys](https://iteratehq.com/lp/customer-surveys): Customer survey software for product, research, and marketing teams

## Comparisons
- [Compare Iterate](https://iteratehq.com/compare): Browse comparisons with other customer feedback and survey platforms
- [Iterate vs Delighted](https://iteratehq.com/vs/delighted): Compare Iterate and Delighted for customer feedback
- [Iterate vs Qualtrics](https://iteratehq.com/vs/qualtrics): Compare Iterate and Qualtrics for customer feedback
- [Iterate vs SurveyMonkey](https://iteratehq.com/vs/surveymonkey): Compare Iterate and SurveyMonkey for customer feedback
- [Iterate vs Survicate](https://iteratehq.com/vs/survicate): Compare Iterate and Survicate for customer feedback
- [Iterate vs Typeform](https://iteratehq.com/vs/typeform): Compare Iterate and Typeform for customer feedback

## Case Studies
- [Match Group](https://iteratehq.com/case-study/match-group): How Match Group uses Iterate for customer feedback
- [Quizlet](https://iteratehq.com/case-study/quizlet): How Quizlet uses Iterate to understand student needs

## Company
- [Pricing](https://iteratehq.com/pricing): Plans for companies of all sizes with a 14 day free trial
- [Customers](https://iteratehq.com/customers): Companies using Iterate
- [Security](https://iteratehq.com/security): Security practices and data protection
- [Privacy Policy](https://iteratehq.com/privacy): Privacy policy and data handling
- [Terms of Use](https://iteratehq.com/terms): Terms of service
- [Contact](https://iteratehq.com/contact): Get in touch with the Iterate team

You ask. We answer.

A little more about how Iterate works, plays with your tools, and helps you learn from your customers.

What is Iterate?

Iterate is an enterprise survey platform for product, research, and lifecycle marketing teams. Deliver surveys in-app, by email, and on the web, with native two-way integrations for Braze and Iterable. Surveys launch from existing campaigns, and every response writes back to the user's profile in real time. Trusted by 10,000+ companies including The New York Times, SeatGeek, Match Group, Estée Lauder, Quizlet, ProPublica, NBCUniversal, and Anheuser-Busch.

How does Iterate integrate with Braze and Iterable?

Surveys launch from existing Braze campaigns and Canvas flows, or from Iterable campaigns and Journeys, using the segments already defined there. Each response returns to Braze or Iterable as a user attribute on the respondent's profile and as a custom event. Both are available inside the engagement platform with no export step. No per-question field mapping is required.

Can I use Iterate with Claude or other AI assistants?

Yes. Iterate's MCP server connects Claude, Codex, Gemini, and other compatible assistants to your surveys and feedback. Create a survey in conversation, explore responses, and uncover themes in plain language. When your survey is ready, review and launch it in Iterate. Explore the MCP server.

Can I run Iterate surveys without installing an SDK?

Yes. A marketer can build a survey, target an existing Braze or Iterable segment, and send it through a Braze Canvas or Iterable Journey without installing the Iterate SDK or waiting on engineering. Surveys appear inside email, or inside an app where Braze or Iterable is already set up. For in-app delivery through Braze, use the Custom Code message type in a Braze In-App Messaging campaign.

Can a survey response trigger a Braze or Iterable campaign?

Yes. Responses write back to Braze and Iterable as user attributes and custom events, so they are available for segmentation and campaign targeting as soon as they are submitted. An NPS detractor score can trigger a retention Canvas in Braze. A feature satisfaction response can update personalization in the next Iterable campaign. No export required.

How do I run NPS surveys through Braze or Iterable?

Build the NPS survey in Iterate, target an existing Braze or Iterable segment, and send it through a Braze Canvas or Iterable Journey, by email or in-app. Each score writes back to the user's profile as an attribute and a custom event. Detractors can route into a retention Canvas in Braze or a follow-up campaign in Iterable. No SDK install and no engineering work.

How do Iterate email surveys work?

The first question appears in the email body. Each answer option is a link. One click records the answer and opens question two in the browser. Emails are sent from your own domain with DKIM and SPF set up. Each response writes back to the respondent's Braze or Iterable profile. Send email surveys through Braze campaigns and Canvases, Iterable campaigns and Journeys, and Klaviyo flows.

How do Iterate in-app surveys work on iOS and Android?

Iterate's iOS and Android SDKs deliver in-app surveys triggered by specific behavioral events: immediately after an action, after a configured time delay, or on session start. Because the survey never leaves the app, response rates are up to 3x higher than tools that redirect users to a browser. React Native is also supported. Responses write back to the same Braze and Iterable profiles your campaigns already use.

Why are Iterate response rates higher?

In email, the first question is in the email body and one click records the answer. In-app, the iOS or Android SDK shows the survey inside the app. Neither channel sends the user to a browser before the first question. Response rates are up to 3x higher than tools that do.

Can Iterate target surveys using the segments I already have?

Yes. Survey targeting uses the segments and behavioral data already defined in Braze, Iterable, and Klaviyo. There is no need to recreate your audience in Iterate or export data. When a track event fires in Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, or Segment, Iterate shows a targeted survey to that user.

How does Iterate support continuous customer research?

Surveys launch from behavioral events and lifecycle campaigns in Braze, Iterable, and Klaviyo. Define the trigger once and the survey fires every time that condition is met: after onboarding, after a purchase, at renewal, or right after a feature is used. Each response writes back to the customer profile in Braze or Iterable, so the program runs inside the engagement platform.

How does Iterate compare with Survicate?

Both platforms offer native mobile SDKs with event triggering and integrations with Braze, Klaviyo, and Iterable. The differences are configuration and pricing. Survicate's integrations use explicit question-to-attribute field mapping; Iterate writes every response back as an attribute and an event without per-question mapping. Survicate prices on response volume; Iterate prices on audience size with unlimited responses. Read the full comparison with Survicate.

How does Iterate pricing work?

Iterate prices on audience size with unlimited responses. The number of surveys you run and the number of responses you collect do not change the bill.

Enterprise-grade security and compliance.

Your customers' trust is important to you, and it's important to us too.
Iterate is SOC 2 Type II certified, GDPR and CCPA ready, and HIPAA compliant, so teams in healthcare and other regulated industries can collect feedback with confidence.

Learn more about security at Iterate ↗
